title: Eu(III)-doped downconverting nanophosphors (GdVO4:Eu3+) for selective and sensitive detection of arsenic(III) in water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2699-2709
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00885E, Paper
Jitender Kumar, Indrajit Roy
This study presents a selective and sensitive photoluminescent nanosensor for As3+ detection. DCNPs (GdVO4:Eu3+) exhibit strong luminescence, quenched by As3+ binding via aggregation. With a 39 nM detection limit, it ensures reliable arsenic sensing.
